name: 诺伦·晨曦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:240
who: Nolen of Dawnridge, the emperor of the young Dawn empire, about 177 cm, tall and straight, narrow in the waist, straight in the shoulder and long in the leg. Never once seen out of armour: a full suit of bright mirror-polished silver plate engraved all over with fine flowing script and sunrise rays, built like the armour in the reference pictures, and a closed helm shaped like a lion's head with the visor down, a great mane of pale gold hair spilling out of the helm over the shoulders like a lion's mane, no crown on top; no face, no skin and no hair of his own is ever seen, only a thin line of green light through the visor slit. Over the plate a huge white cloak with a deep white fur collar, falling to the ground. On his back the great two-handed sword Dawn, white-gold, broad and straight, longer than a man, the blade showing no stain. A calm, level, unhurried bearing, someone who has never once been seen without the helm.
face: FACE: a closed bright silver helm shaped like a lion's head with the visor fully down, a mane of pale gold hair spilling from the helm around the shoulders, NO face visible, NO skin visible, only a thin line of green light through the visor slit; no crown, no plume; in every outfit and every pose the visor stays down and the helm stays on.
build: 177 cm, tall and straight: a narrow waist, straight shoulders and long legs under the plate; no bare body is shown.
palette: mirror-bright silver with fine engraved script, white fur and white cloth, pale gold mane, deep blue cloth under the plate, one thin line of green
casual: His everyday self, the only self anyone sees: the full engraved silver plate, the lion-head helm with the visor down and the pale gold mane, a deep-blue arming cloth showing at the joints and in the split skirts beneath the plate, the great white fur-collared cloak over all, a dark leather belt, the great white-gold sword Dawn slung across his back; one gauntleted hand resting on the belt, only a thin line of green in the visor slit.
private: At rest in camp, still in the full plate and the lion helm with the visor down: the white cloak off and folded over a stool beside him, the great sword unslung and leaning at hand, one gauntlet removed and held in the other hand, seated upright on a plain wooden camp stool with the hands resting on the knees, a calm, quiet posture; the green line in the visor looks toward the fire.
battle: In the field: the engraved silver plate and the lion helm, the white cloak streaming back from the shoulders, the great white-gold sword Dawn drawn and held two-handed point-up in front of him, the broad straight blade clean and bright, the feet planted wide, the mane and the fur collar stirring; a thin line of green through the visor slit.
formal: At the founding of the alliance: the plate polished to a mirror shine, the lion helm with the visor down, the great white cloak with its fur collar arranged over both shoulders and falling to the ground, the great sword Dawn planted point-down in front of him with both gauntlets folded on the pommel, standing very upright and still; only a thin line of green in the visor slit.
art: A portrait to the chest: the lion-head helm with the visor down turned slightly toward the viewer, no face visible, a thin line of green light glowing through the visor slit, the pale gold mane and the deep white fur collar filling the frame, the engraved pauldron with its sunrise ray in the foreground. Cold pale dawn light from one side, a warm low gold from the other. Foreground blur: drifting red dust and sparks of firelight.

name: 诺伦·晨曦（未穿甲）
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:240
who: Nolen of Dawnridge as no one has ever seen her, out of the armour and without the helm: a tall, strikingly beautiful young woman of about 177 cm with an excellent figure, long-legged, narrow-waisted and straight-shouldered, carrying herself exactly as the armoured emperor does; the face and hair follow the reference pictures, the clothes follow the descriptions below; the sword is the same great sword as in the third reference picture (the armoured figure): the two-handed sword Dawn, white-gold, broad and straight, longer than she is tall. Pale gold hair gathered into a braided bun at the back of the head with one long strand left loose beside the face and one short lock standing up at the crown, clear teal-green eyes, a fine, composed, beautiful face with a cool, level look, composed enough that in armour it has always passed for a young man's; fair skin. The bearing of a commander, calm and unhurried; the beauty is in the face and the carriage, fully clothed and never shown off.
build: 177 cm, tall and straight with an excellent athletic figure: long legs, a narrow waist, straight shoulders, shown only through fitted, closed clothing.
palette: deep blue wool and white cloth, gold thread, pale gold hair, teal-green eyes, brass and leather
casual: Her own self in the quiet of the command tent, dressed as a commander of the founding war dresses under the plate: a fitted deep-blue wool arming coat with a high collar, closed down the front with a row of small plain brass buttons, a gold sunrise ray stitched on the breast, a white half-cloak of the Dawn banner hung from the left shoulder, a wide leather belt with a brass buckle, slim dark trousers, tall riding boots and leather gloves, the great two-handed sword Dawn, white-gold and longer than she is tall, slung across her back with its hilt rising above her shoulder and the scabbard tip reaching her calves; the braided bun with the long loose strand. She stands straight with one gloved hand resting on the belt, a cool, level look.
private: Late at night, alone: a loose white shirt with the collar closed and the sleeves rolled to the forearm, slim dark trousers, soft indoor boots, the hair let down to the shoulders in one loose braid; she sits upright on a camp stool with a cup of water in both hands, looking at the lamp, a quiet, tired, honest face.
battle: Caught without the plate: the deep-blue wool arming coat belted tight, leather bracers and gloves, the white half-cloak thrown back, the great two-handed sword Dawn, white-gold, broad and straight and longer than she is tall, exactly as in the armoured reference picture, held two-handed point-up in front of her with the tip rising well above her head, the feet planted wide, the bun tight; her whole bearing is the emperor's, only without the armour.
formal: A formal evening no court has seen, in the dress of that age: a long white wool court coat of the Dawn banner's white, reaching the knee, with gold sunrise rays embroidered down the front and along the hem, over a high-collared deep-blue tunic, a deep-blue sash at the waist, white gloves, slim dark trousers and polished tall boots, a thin gold circlet in the braided hair; she stands very straight with the hands folded before her, a cool, elegant, level look.
art: A portrait to the chest, the face turned slightly to the viewer, the clear teal-green eyes cool and level, the pale gold braided bun with the long strand beside the face and the one lock standing at the crown, the high collar of the deep-blue wool arming coat with its brass buttons and gold sunrise ray and the white half-cloak. Cold pale dawn light from one side, a warm low gold from the other. Foreground blur: a few drifting gold sparks and the hilt of a white-gold sword.

name: 克努特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:304
who: Knut, a human charcoal-burner's son from Dawnridge, twenty years old, a spearman in the front rank. About 183 cm, tall and thin, narrow shoulders, a long neck with a big Adam's apple. A mop of tousled wheat-coloured hair. Small black soot specks on his face that never wash out. Sky-blue eyes that blink fast when he is afraid. Big hands covered in spear-shaft calluses. He wears no armour beyond a worn jerkin with the dawn crest stitched on the chest. An earnest, nervous, stubborn young man who stands his ground.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young man's long face, NOT round: medium-large, slightly slanted sky-blue eyes with a thin dark-brown upper lash line and wide-open lids; light-brown eyebrows; a scatter of tiny soot-grey specks across the nose and cheeks; a long straight nose; a thin, nervous mouth; a prominent Adam's apple. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin with narrow shoulders and long limbs, wiry but strong in the hands and forearms.
palette: wheat blond, sky blue, soot grey, worn leather brown, a little dawn gold
casual: His spearman's kit: a worn leather jerkin with the elbows rubbed through, the Dawnridge dawn crest stitched on the chest, over a plain wool shirt, brown trousers and sturdy boots; a charcoal-grey cloth pouch at the belt holding flint and half a loaf; he holds a long spear upright beside him, the shaft new and the head ground by himself, a nervous, earnest look.
private: Off duty by the fire: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, boots off and the feet in thick wool socks, the charcoal pouch beside him. He sits cross-legged with half a loaf in his hands, blinking, a shy, tired little smile.
battle: In the spear line: the worn jerkin with the dawn crest stitched on the chest, a dawn-gold cloth band on the upper arm, leather bracers, a plain open-faced iron cap with a sunrise painted on the brow. He levels the long spear in both hands, braced low at his hip, a small sunrise rune etched on the spearhead glinting, feet planted wide. A frightened but stubborn look, the jaw clenched.
formal: At the muster of the army: a clean linen shirt under the best of his jerkin, the Dawnridge dawn crest freshly stitched on the chest, a clean dawn-gold cloth band on the upper arm, hair combed flat and still springing up, the spear held upright at his side. He stands straight, very serious, trying not to blink.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the sky-blue eyes wide and unblinking at the viewer with a stubborn effort, the soot specks clear on the cheeks. Low red light from the right, cool pale light from the left. Foreground blur: a forest of spear shafts and drifting red dust.

name: 卢茨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:360
who: Lutz, a human blacksmith's apprentice from the White Crown city, nineteen years old, the army's standard-bearer. About 168 cm, short, sturdy and wide in the shoulders from swinging a hammer. Very short, cropped fire-red hair. A burn scar behind his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Pale gold eyes that look upward when he looks at his flag. Big rough hands, the knuckles dotted with small old forge scars. A stubborn, steady, proud air: he stands straighter than the pole he carries.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's broad, square, honest face, NOT delicate: medium-large pale gold eyes, slightly upturned, under thick short fire-red eyebrows; a short straight nose; a firm mouth; a faint soot smudge on one cheek; the burn scar behind the left ear. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 168 cm, short and sturdy with very broad shoulders and thick forearms, a solid chest and strong legs.
palette: fire red, pale gold, forge iron grey, soot black, white and dawn gold for the banner
casual: His standard-bearer's kit: a chest piece made from a smith's leather apron, the front studded with iron plates he hammered himself, over a plain wool shirt, brown trousers and heavy boots; on his back a long white ash-wood pole topped with an iron spearhead, the army's banner on it a white cloth with a single gold sunrise; a small smith's hammer hanging at the belt. He grips the pole upright with a proud look, eyes lifted.
private: Off duty at the forge fire: a sleeveless leather smith's apron over a loose linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, rolled trousers and old boots, the banner furled and leaned in the corner. He turns a half-finished iron plate in his hands, a cheerful, focused look.
battle: Carrying the banner into the line: the iron-studded apron chest piece, leather bracers, a plain iron cap, the white banner with its gold sunrise unfurled and held high in both hands on its ash pole, the feet planted wide against the wind; a fierce, unwavering upward look.
formal: Before the emperor: the chest piece cleaned and oiled, a clean white linen shirt, a fresh dawn-gold sash across the chest, the banner held upright and perfectly straight in both hands, his short red hair damp and combed. He stands rigid, proud, the eyes lifted to the flag.
art: A portrait seen from slightly below, the face large, the pale gold eyes looking up at the banner above the frame, a proud, steady expression. Wind-whipped white cloth with a gold sunrise at the top of the frame, warm gold light from above, cool grey from the side. Foreground blur: the ash pole and streaming cloth edge.

name: 哈特穆特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:416
who: Hartmut, a human adjutant of the emperor, thirty-five years old, a rock-steady veteran. About 176 cm, broad and solid, straight in the back. A square face with a nose that was broken once and now bends to his own left (the viewer's right when he faces us). Short-cropped blue-black hair, the temples already white. Deep green eyes that never blink when they look at a person. Very steady hands. He carries a round shield with a worn dawn motif and a short sword; in the breast pocket of his coat is a small carved wooden tag. A calm, dependable, watchful air that settles frightened horses. His nose is OBVIOUSLY broken and crooked, plain even at thumbnail size: a hard bump on the bridge and the whole lower half of the nose shoved sideways toward the viewer's right when he faces us, so the two sides of the nose are visibly unequal; a straight, symmetrical nose is wrong for him.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square, weathered man's face of about thirty-five: medium deep green eyes with a steady unblinking gaze under level dark brows; a nose broken once, bent toward the viewer's right; a firm mouth; short blue-black hair with white at the temples. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone. The nose is plainly crooked, NOT straight: the bridge has a hard sideways kink about a third of the way down and everything below the kink leans toward the viewer's right when he faces us, like a boxer's nose that healed badly, clearly drawn in every panel; there are NO scars, cuts or lines drawn across his nose or cheeks.
build: 176 cm, broad and solid with a straight back and strong arms.
palette: deep green, blue-black and temple white, worn leather brown, tarnished steel, a little dawn gold
casual: An adjutant's field dress: a plain dark wool coat buttoned to the chest with a leather belt, sturdy boots, leather gloves, a round wooden shield slung on his back with a dawn motif almost rubbed away, a short sword at the belt with the hilt wrapped in stitched leather; in the breast pocket the edge of a small wooden tag with two carved letters, NOT readable text. A calm, steady look.
private: Quiet in a tent: the coat off, a long-sleeved grey linen shirt open at the neck, belt and sword hung on a post, the wooden tag held in his open palm and turned in the light. A tired, gentle expression.
battle: Holding the door: a plain iron helm under the arm, a mail shirt under the dark coat with the dawn crest stitched at the chest, leather bracers. The round shield braced in front at a slant has a faded sunrise whose paint catches real light, and the short sword is drawn low behind it, the stitched hilt in his fist. An unblinking, immovable look.
formal: Standing behind the emperor at a council: the dark coat brushed and buttoned, a clean white collar, a dawn-gold sash across the chest, the shield slung and the sword sheathed with the stitched hilt, the wooden tag kept in the pocket. He stands straight, hands clasped behind him, a grave, steady look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep green eyes looking straight at the viewer without blinking, the bent nose clear. Warm lamp light from one side, cool grey from the other. Foreground blur: the rim of a round shield and a small carved tag held in an open palm.

name: 古伦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:472
who: Gulen of the rune-engineer line, a dwarf sapper, one hundred and twenty years old and a young adult by dwarf reckoning. About 138 cm, short and wide like a block of stone, arms thicker than an ordinary man's legs. A deep brown beard braided in three plaits down to the chest. Stone-blue eyes that squint at stone. Big square hands. A quiet, patient, stubborn air; he works until the wall stands.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, rugged adult dwarf's face, NOT a child's: small stone-blue eyes narrowed in a squint under heavy dark-brown brows; a wide nose; a strong jaw hidden under a deep brown beard braided in three plaits; weathered cheeks. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 138 cm, short and very broad, block-like, with enormously thick arms and a deep chest.
palette: stone blue, deep brown, mountain-bronze, soft rock grey, worn leather brown
casual: His sapper's kit: a thick leather apron chiselled with rune marks, a row of small chisels hanging along it, over a plain wool shirt and heavy trousers; on his back a rune-engraved shovel with a mountain-bronze-edged blade; at the belt a mason's hammer, its handle covered in tiny notches, one for each person who worked beside him. He holds a white stone block under one arm, a squinting, patient look.
private: Resting after work: the apron hung up, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, wide trousers and soft felt boots, the three beard plaits loosened. He sits on an upturned bucket running a thumb over the notches on a hammer handle, a quiet, warm look.
battle: On the wall: the rune-chiselled apron over a mail shirt, leather bracers, a plain iron cap, the rune shovel driven into the ground in front of him with one hand while the other grips the mason's hammer raised; his feet planted wide, the stone-blue eyes narrowed; a stubborn, immovable look.
formal: At the wall's foundation ceremony: the rune-chiselled leather apron cleaned and oiled, mountain-bronze studs along the straps, a clean dark wool jerkin laced at the sides, a belt buckle cast with the dawn crest, the three beard plaits tied with small mountain-bronze rings. The rune lines on the apron glow faintly. He holds the mason's hammer upright in both hands, standing wide and still, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the stone-blue eyes squinting directly at the viewer as if checking a wall, a grave, patient expression. Grey dust-filled light from above, a warm lamp glow from one side. Foreground blur: a chisel and white stone dust drifting.

name: 托格瑞
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1130
who: Togri of the rune-engineer line, a dwarf sapper, one hundred years old and young by dwarf reckoning. About 132 cm, stocky but a ring leaner than Gulen. A yellow-brown beard braided in two plaits, each plait ending in a small mountain-bronze ring. Copper-coloured eyes that look at a person's hands first. Both hands hard with calluses from winch ropes, a transverse scar across the left palm. A patient, careful, reading air; he reads names out loud and the wall answers.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, adult dwarf's face, NOT a child's: medium copper-coloured eyes with heavy lids and short brown brows; a wide nose; a yellow-brown beard in two plaits with bronze rings at the ends; weathered cheeks. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 132 cm, short and stocky, a little leaner than a block, with thick forearms.
palette: copper, yellow-brown, mountain-bronze, slate grey, worn leather brown
casual: His sapper's kit: a rune-chiselled leather apron, mended in three places, over a plain wool shirt and heavy trousers; on his back a rune-engraved shovel; at the belt a mason's hammer; on a cord at his chest a small slate tablet with name marks scratched on it. He holds a coil of winch rope in one hand, a careful, attentive look.
private: Resting after a shift: the apron hung on a peg, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up to show the rope-burn calluses, soft boots, the beard plaits loosened. He sits with the slate tablet on his knee, reading the scratched names, a quiet, gentle look.
battle: At the gate winch: the mended apron over a mail shirt, leather bracers and an iron cap, both hands hauling hard on a thick winch rope, the body leaning back, the feet braced wide against the stone; a strained, determined look, the copper eyes fixed on the hands.
formal: At the reading of names: a clean wool shirt buttoned high, the apron cleaned and mended, the two beard plaits oiled with fresh bronze rings, the slate tablet held up in both hands in front of his chest. He stands straight and grave, ready to read.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper eyes lowered to the slate tablet held up in his scarred palm, a reading, solemn expression. Warm lamp light from one side, grey stone light from the other. Foreground blur: a hanging rope and drifting stone dust.
art_extra: The slate tablet lies on his open LEFT palm (the hand on the viewer's right when he faces us), the palm turned up toward the viewer so the one straight scar running straight across the palm is clearly seen; the backs of his hands and his right hand carry no scar.

name: 坦西·长辙
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:613
who: Tansy of the Longwheel caravan family, a halfling woman, thirty years old, a lead-wagon driver. About 104 cm, small and round, sturdy. A round freckled face. Ginger curly hair tied up with a red cloth strip into one bunch. Fresh light-green eyes that squint at the road, and a smile that rises on one side of her mouth first. Small hands with rein calluses in the palms. A cheerful, shrewd, steady air: she keeps thirteen wagons moving in step.
palette: ginger, fresh green, red cloth, brass, worn leather brown
casual: Her driver's outfit: a short leather jacket whose hem is hung with a ring of small brass bells (the caravan rule), over a plain wool blouse and a knee-length skirt with leggings and sturdy boots; in her right hand a driving whip that only taps the shaft, never the animal; on her back a tin tube holding a long scroll. She stands on the wagon-board with the reins in her other hand, a lopsided smile.
private: Resting by the wagon: the jacket off and hung on the wheel, a loose undyed linen blouse with the sleeves pushed up and a long wool skirt, soft boots, the red-banded bunch of curls loosened a little. She eats a bun on the wagon step with her feet swinging, a relaxed, warm look.
battle: Holding the lead wagon: the bell-hemmed jacket buckled, leather bracers, a plain iron cap strapped under the chin, the driving whip coiled in one fist and the other hand gripping the reins of four mules, the body braced low on the wagon-board; a determined, shrewd look.
formal: At the signing of the long scroll: a clean embroidered wool bodice-dress with a white collar, the bell jacket swapped for a small shoulder cape hemmed with brass bells, fresh red ribbon in her curls, the scroll tube held upright against her chest. She stands tall as she can, a proud, polite smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the green eyes squinting at the viewer with a lopsided smile. Warm low sun from one side lights the ginger curls and freckles, a soft blue shadow on the other. Foreground blur: swinging brass bells and a wagon wheel spoke.

name: 芬顿
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:669
who: Fenton, a halfling brewer and the head of the Full-Barn house, sixty years old. About 102 cm, short, plump, with a round belly. A white beard trimmed into two upturned points. A red nose and a face always creased with laughter lines. Honey-coloured eyes that squint to judge the colour of wine. Plump hands with fresh calluses from digging a cellar. A genial, welcoming, hearty air: he cannot see a passer-by without offering a cup.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, jovial older halfling man's face: small honey-coloured eyes narrowed in smile creases; white eyebrows; a red round nose; a white beard trimmed into two upturned points; rosy cheeks. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: honey amber, beard white, rosy red, beeswax cream, wine-barrel brown
casual: His brewer's clothes: an apron stained with beeswax over a plain linen shirt and a brown waistcoat, rolled trousers and clogs; a small brass tasting spoon stuck in the apron pocket; hanging at his belt a ring of a dozen cellar keys that jingle when he walks. He holds out a small wooden cup, a hearty, welcoming grin.
private: Resting on the porch: the apron off, a loose cream shirt with the sleeves rolled and the collar open, braces loose, soft slippers. He sits in a rocker with a cup of mead on his belly, the keys on a nail beside him, eyes half closed, a contented smile.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: braced and determined, the knees bent and the feet planted a little wider, carrying a small sealed cask on one shoulder with both hands and the keys swinging at his belt; he fights no one and holds no weapon; a firm, steady expression with the jaw set.
battle: On the road with the wagons: a waxed travelling cloak over the apron, a wide felt hat, cloth gaiters and sturdy boots, the ring of cellar keys at the belt and the brass spoon in the pocket; he fights no one and carries no weapon; instead he shoulders a small sealed cask, both hands holding it, the knees braced, a firm, steady look.
formal: As host at the harvest table: his best brown waistcoat with brass buttons over a clean white shirt, a wheat-gold sash, the beard waxed into sharp upturned points, the cellar keys polished and a small cup raised in one hand. He stands with a broad, genial smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-coloured eyes crinkled in a hearty smile, the upturned white beard sharp. Warm low amber light from one side as if from a lantern in a cellar, cool shade on the other. Foreground blur: a hanging ring of keys and a glimmering wooden cup.

name: 乌格拉斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:781
who: Uglas, a demon-kin man of the east, thirty years old, the leader of those who filed their horns. About 188 cm, tall and lean with broad shoulders. A long face. Two crooked horns: the one on the viewer's left curves forward and the one on the viewer's right curves backward, the horn roots still showing the file marks from his childhood. Pale grey skin. Deep yellow eyes that look straight at a person. Short slate-blue hair. A red scar across the palm of his right hand (his right, the viewer's left when he faces us). A steady, plain, sure air that makes those behind him walk in his footprints.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, strong-jawed man's face of thirty: medium deep yellow eyes with a direct, level gaze under straight dark slate-blue brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; pale grey skin with very little shading; two crooked horns, no flame on them. Skin shadows are a soft cool grey-lilac.
build: 188 cm, tall and lean with broad shoulders and long arms.
palette: pale grey, deep yellow, slate blue, worn leather brown, dawn gold
casual: His outfit: an old leather armour with a plain unmarked chest, over a dark wool shirt, grey trousers and boots; an iron sword at the hip, its spine engraved with his grandfather's name (a few small marks, NOT readable text); on his back a wooden shield on which he has painted a single crooked dawn ray. He stands steady with one hand on the sword hilt, a direct look.
private: At the camp fire: the leather armour off, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and a lace open at the neck, the sword and the shield set beside him. He rubs the red scar across his right palm with his left thumb, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Leading through a bog: the old plain leather armour buckled, leather bracers and greaves, the wooden shield with the crooked dawn ray in fresh paint raised on his left arm. The iron sword is drawn in his right hand and pointed forward, the small marks on its spine warming with a dull heat shimmer. Feet planted wide, a steady, forward look, the yellow eyes level.
formal: Before the long scroll: the old leather armour brushed clean, a clean dark wool coat over it, the wooden shield slung on his back and the sword sheathed, one palm held open to show the red scar. He stands tall and still, a grave, plain look. The open palm showing the red scar is his RIGHT hand, on the viewer's left when he faces us; the left hand hangs at his side and has no mark.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep yellow eyes looking straight at the viewer, the two crooked horns breaking the frame. Cold grey-green rain light from one side, a dull red from the other. Foreground blur: rain drops and the edge of a wooden shield.

name: 伊格瓦尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:927
who: Igvar of the Skyridge clan, a dragonkin warrior of the keepers of the scale stone, fifty-nine years old but looking about forty, since dragonkin age slower than men. About 192 cm, tall, broad in the shoulders, long in the arm and leg. Dark bronze-coloured scales cover his jaw, the sides of his neck and both forearms, thickening upward and stopping at the corners of his eyes. Amber vertical pupils. Dark red hair cut to the shoulders and tied back with a leather cord. A steady, quiet, protective air; he carries a roll of names and has counted everyone who went west.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong, rugged man's face of about forty: amber vertical-pupil eyes with a level gaze under straight dark red brows; dark bronze scales along the jaw and the corners of the eyes; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth, no fangs showing; dark red hair to the shoulders. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 192 cm, tall with wide shoulders, long hands and feet, a heavy, powerful frame.
palette: dark bronze, deep red, amber, bone white, worn leather brown
casual: His clan outfit: a scale-pattern leather armour of the Skyridge clan, the chest stamped with a standing stone set with scales, over a dark wool shirt and trousers and boots; on his back a large round dragon-bone shield; at the hip an iron sword in a plain scabbard; hung on his chest a leather pouch holding a charcoal stick and a rolled list of names. He stands solid and calm, hand on the sword.
private: Resting at the camp: the armour off, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up to show the bronze forearm scales, the hair cord loosened. He sits on a log with the roll of names on his knee, a charcoal stick in his hand, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Holding the pass: the scale-pattern armour buckled, leather bracers over the scaled forearms, the dragon-bone shield on the left arm raised in front of him, the iron sword drawn in the right hand low behind it, feet planted wide, a low glow in the amber eyes; a calm, immovable look.
formal: At the clan's gate: the scale armour cleaned and oiled, a clean dark red clan cloak pinned at the shoulder, the dragon-bone shield on his back, the roll of names held in both hands before his chest. He stands straight and still, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber vertical-pupil eyes looking steadily at the viewer, the bronze scales along the jaw catching the light. A warm firelight glow from one side, snow-cold blue from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and the rim of a bone shield.

name: 汉诺
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:985
who: Hanno, a human heavy cavalryman, grandson of the emperor's adjutant, forty-two years old. About 179 cm, broad and solid, with a slight bow in the legs from long years in the saddle. A square face and a straight nose, a younger copy of his grandfather's face without the break. Short-cropped blue-black hair, the temples just turning white. Light violet eyes like his father's. A steady, plain, ready air: you can tell by his stance that today the horse will charge.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square, weathered man's face of about forty: medium light violet eyes with a level gaze under straight dark brows; a straight nose; a firm mouth; short blue-black hair with a little white at the temples. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 179 cm, broad and solid with slightly bowed legs and heavy shoulders.
palette: light violet, blue-black, black-stone dark grey with silver sheen, dawn gold
casual: His rider's gear: a coat of black heavy-cavalry plate whose scales are mixed with pale silver dust that glints cold, over a quilted gambeson and boots, a plain open helm carried under the arm; a cavalry lance in the right hand, a long sword at the hip with a hilt his father carved; in his breast pocket the edge of a small wooden tag with two carved letters, NOT readable text. A steady, ready look.
private: At rest in the stable: the plate off and hung on a rack, a quilted gambeson open at the neck over a plain linen shirt, rolled sleeves, soft boots. He curries a horse with a brush in his right hand, the wooden tag glimpsed in his left palm, a quiet, tired smile.
battle: In the charge: the black cavalry plate with silver dust flashing cold, a closed helm with the visor up, the lance levelled in the right hand at a slant forward, the long sword at the hip, leaning in as if mounted, the legs braced wide; a hard, ready look.
formal: At the council: the black cavalry plate polished, a dawn-gold sash across the chest and a short cloak, the helm tucked under the arm, the long sword sheathed with its carved hilt, the lance left aside. He stands upright with the left hand resting on the pommel, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light violet eyes looking steadily at the viewer, a cold flash of silver dust glinting on the pauldron. A grey cold sky light from one side, a dull red from the other. Foreground blur: the point of a lance and drifting dust.

name: 莱因霍尔德
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1186
who: Reinhold of the White Kite knightly house, a human knight, thirty years old, the house's eldest son. About 186 cm, tall and lean, broad in the shoulders. A narrow face with a hard jawline. Short light-gold hair with a few white strands already. Ice-blue eyes that look at people as if counting them. A disciplined, proud, exact air; he can lead a column of young men whose hooves strike in step.
face: FACE, as in the references: a narrow, hard-jawed man's face of thirty: medium ice-blue eyes with a calculating gaze under straight pale-gold brows; a straight nose; a thin firm mouth; short light-gold hair with a few white strands. Skin shadows are a soft cool tone.
build: 186 cm, tall and lean with broad shoulders and long limbs.
palette: ice blue, pale gold, black-stone grey with silver sheen, kite white
casual: His knight's gear: a coat of black heavy-cavalry plate whose scales are mixed with pale silver dust that glints cold, the breastplate engraved with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, over a quilted gambeson and boots; a cavalry lance held upright in the right hand, a long sword at the hip, a plain open helm under the left arm. A disciplined, level look.
private: Off duty at the house: the plate off, a plain dark wool coat buttoned to the chin over a linen shirt, soft boots, a cup of wine in one hand and a letter in the other. He sits upright on a bench by the window, a reserved, thoughtful look.
battle: At the head of the charge: the black plate with silver dust flashing cold, a closed helm with the visor up, the lance levelled forward at a slant in the right hand, the long sword at the hip, the body leaning in as if on horseback, the legs braced wide; a hard, exact look.
formal: At the house's table: the black plate polished, the breastplate kite bright, a short white mantle with the kite pinned at the shoulder, the helm under the arm, the long sword sheathed and a gloved hand on the pommel. He stands very upright, a proud, formal look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes looking at the viewer as if counting, the silver-dusted pauldron glinting cold. Pale cold light from one side, a dim warm gold from the other. Foreground blur: a lance point and drifting fine dust.

name: 加兹
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1242
who: Gaz, a shadow-demon man of the camp of the named ones, thirty years old, a shadow walker. About 172 cm, thin and not tall, with long hands and long legs, a step that makes no sound. Two thin short horns curving backward, each tipped with a tiny dark-violet flame as small as a candle wick (NOT a cigarette). Ash-white skin. Dark violet vertical-pupil eyes that glow in shadow. Messy short silver-grey hair. A quiet, quick, watchful air; he keeps half a step away from everyone, like his own shadow.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, sharp young man's face: medium-large dark violet vertical-pupil eyes with a thin dark upper lash line; thin level silver-grey eyebrows; a straight small nose; a thin closed mouth; ash-white skin; two thin short horns curving backward with tiny dark-violet flames at the tips. Skin shadows are a soft cool grey-lilac.
build: 172 cm, thin and wiry with long hands and long legs.
palette: ash white, dark violet, soot black-grey, bone, a little silver
casual: His shadow-walker kit: a short soot-grey leather jacket with tight cuffs and a tight hem, dark close-fitting trousers and soft soled boots, nothing dangling that could rattle; two short knives at the belt, one plain and one carved of bone. He stands very still, the shadow behind him a half-step late, a watchful look.
private: In the camp at night: the jacket off, a loose long-sleeved dark linen shirt, soft slippers, the bone-handled knife held in his palm and turned over, sitting against a wall in the dark. A quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: In the dark: the soot-grey jacket buckled tight, leather bracers, a dark scarf over the lower face pulled down, both short knives drawn and held low, one forward and one back, the body crouched and ready, the shadow stretching long behind him; a sharp, silent look.
formal: At the camp's meeting: a clean soot-grey leather short coat laced at the side, with close cuffs and hem so nothing rattles and a band of dark violet thread stitched along the cuffs that seems to drink the lamplight. Both knives are sheathed and hidden, his hair combed flat. He stands just outside the circle of lamplight, hands clasped behind him, a reserved look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark violet vertical-pupil eyes glowing faintly in the dark and looking at the viewer, a tiny violet flame on each horn tip. Low cold violet light from below, a thin warm light on the edge. Foreground blur: his own long shadow and drifting soot.

name: 赫拉娜
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1603
who: Helana, a scattered-blood dragonkin woman, a blacksmith's daughter from the White Crown city, who walked out of the Reverse-Scale Valley bare-handed and has looked twenty ever since. About 168 cm, slim and strong. Short rust-red hair in a plain practical braid. Amber vertical pupils that cannot be hidden. Only a few scales on the back of her neck. Around her neck on a leather cord hangs one thin, translucent dragon scale so thin that light passes through it, with no marking on it at all. Her fingernails are thin. She carries no weapon, ever. A hard, quiet, short-spoken air; she notices first whether a person hides something.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's lean, serious face: medium amber vertical-pupil almond eyes under straight rust-red brows; a straight small nose; a closed firm mouth; a few small scales at the nape of the neck. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 168 cm, slim and strong: lean arms with hard forearms, a modest bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: rust red, amber, translucent scale white, iron grey, worn leather brown
casual: Her everyday dress: a plain linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow under a short sleeveless leather vest, plain trousers and sturdy boots, a leather cord at her neck with the thin translucent dragon scale hanging at the collarbone. She carries no weapon and stands with her bare hands at her sides, a hard, direct look.
private: At rest in the camp: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen tunic belted with a cord, plain trousers and soft boots, the braid over one shoulder, the thin scale at her neck. She sits with her knees up and turns the scale in her fingers so the fire shines through it, a quiet, distant look.
battle: Holding the gate: the sleeveless leather vest buckled tight over the linen shirt, leather bracers over bare forearms, plain trousers and boots; she has no weapon and stands with her bare fists raised in a plain guard, the feet planted wide and the body braced low, the thin scale swinging at her neck; a fierce, unflinching look.
formal: At the council on the mountain: a plain grey wool tunic with a wide leather belt, the sleeves pushed to the elbow, a short sleeveless vest of scale-pattern leather edged in rust-red thread, the collar open and the braid neatly tied. The thin translucent scale hangs outside the collar and catches a warm ember glow. She stands straight with her hands at her sides and no other ornament, a firm, plain look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber vertical-pupil eyes looking straight at the viewer, the translucent dragon scale held up beside her cheek letting the light pass through it. Cold clear mountain light from one side, a warm amber glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow and a bare hand.

name: 卡尔戈·玄鳞
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1620
who: Kargo of the Dark-Scale clan, a dragonkin who keeps the mountain pass at the top of Skyridge and who has looked forty-nine for thousands of years. About 188 cm, tall and thin. Half of his dark blue-green scales have fallen off, the rest sparsely scattered, and he never hides it. Under his throat a pale scar where a reverse-growing scale used to be. Amber vertical pupils that look down first, at people's feet. Short blue-black hair cut to the ears with dark blue-green scales among it. A short, level, unhurried air; each sentence is a rule that he does not take back. The clan robe is cut like a western long wool travelling coat: a soft narrow collar that lies flat and opens at the throat (NO stiff upright collar), one row of plain round buttons down the front, fitted sleeves, no trimmed or embroidered placket, the hem at mid-shin over trousers and boots.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, weathered man's face of about fifty: medium amber vertical-pupil eyes under straight dark brows; a few sparse dark blue-green scales along the temples and jaw; a closed firm mouth; short blue-black hair; a pale scar under the throat. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 188 cm, tall and thin with a straight back and long hands.
palette: dark blue-green, amber, worn grey-brown, bone white, snow grey
casual: His keeper's clothes: the clan's long grey-brown robe, closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the cuffs worn through, tied with a plain cord belt, over plain trousers and boots; a short dragon-bone knife at the belt and a long-handled broom in his hand for sweeping the snow off the stone. The sparse scales on the neck and the forearms are left bare. A level look cast downward.
private: Warm by the pass fire: the robe open over a plain undyed wool shirt, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, soft boots, the broom leaned against the wall. He sits with a mug in both hands and looks at the snow, a still, quiet look.
battle: At the pass: the grey-brown robe with the sleeves tied back and a leather belt, leather bracers over the scaled forearms, the dragon-bone knife drawn in the right hand low and the broom's long handle held crossways in the left like a staff, the feet planted wide; a calm, immovable look.
formal: As the Keeper at the scale stone: the clan's grey-brown robe cleaned and mended, closed with bone toggles and cord rather than buttons, a scale-stamped leather pauldron on one shoulder, a plain dark blue-green sash, a string of fallen scales around his neck glowing faintly. The broom is set aside and the dragon-bone knife sheathed. He stands upright and still with both hands folded, a grave look cast downward.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber vertical-pupil eyes lowered to look at the viewer's feet and then slowly rising, a legend's quiet eyes with the years behind them. Cold snow light from one side, a faint amber glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and the bristles of a broom.

name: 哈尔加·石踵
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1638
who: Halga Stonebeel, a dwarf forge-smith of the Roaring Cliff's outer forge, who held a narrow bridge alone for a day and has looked about one hundred and eighty years old ever since. About 136 cm, short, strong and wide as a shield. A red-brown beard braided in two plaits. Iron-grey eyes that read the heat of a forge. His boots are worn through at the soles, a crack in the left one stitched with copper wire. A short, plain, numbers-only air; he sells not a single shield and fears only spiders.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered older dwarf's face: small iron-grey eyes under heavy red-brown brows, a flat wide nose, a red-brown beard in two plaits to the belt, deep lines at the eyes. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 136 cm, short and very wide like a shield, with thick arms and a deep chest.
palette: red-brown, iron grey, forge orange, soot black, worn leather brown
casual: His smith's gear: a thick leather apron burnt with many small holes over a plain wool shirt and heavy trousers, a big two-handed war hammer on his back, two spare hammer-hafts at the belt, and the worn-through boots with the copper-wire-stitched crack in the left one. He stands wide with one hand on the hammer, a short, level look.
private: Resting at the forge door: the apron hung up, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to show thick forearms, the boots off beside him and thick wool socks on his feet, a mug on his knee. A quiet, gruff look.
battle: On the bridge: the burnt apron over a mail shirt, leather bracers and an iron cap, a tall round shield on the left arm planted in front of him, the war hammer gripped in the right hand raised, feet planted wide in the worn boots; an immovable, grim look.
formal: At the bridge's stone: the apron brushed clean, a clean dark wool coat over it, the red-brown beard plaits oiled, the war hammer set head-down before him with both hands resting on the haft. He stands wide and still, a grave, plain look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the iron-grey eyes looking at the viewer as if judging the heat of a forge, a legend's quiet eyes with the years behind them. Orange forge light from below on one side, cold grey on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the edge of a shield.

name: 恩雅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:1250
who: Enya, the human name of a young true dragon of the Yellow-Rock line, here in her human form as a stone-hauler on the great white wall; she looks about twenty-two and never ages. About 186 cm, tall, broad-shouldered, heavy-boned and strong, with long arms. Ash-white hair cut short and uneven just below the ears (she hacked it off with a chisel). Amber eyes: round pupils by day, narrowing into vertical slits at night or when she is roused. Fair skin; not a single callus on her hands, but the knuckles of both hands carry a pale chalky-white stone sheen that never washes off. No jewelry, no glasses, no weapon. A slow, steady, quiet air; she says little, carries more than anyone, and never steps around anyone on a ladder.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's calm, strong face of about twenty-two: level amber almond eyes under straight ash-white brows; a straight nose; a closed, steady mouth; a firm jaw; ash-white hair cut short and uneven below the ears; fair skin with a faint wind-flush on the cheeks. Skin shadows are a soft cool tone.
build: 186 cm, tall with wide shoulders, a heavy, strong, thick-boned frame and long arms.
palette: ash white, amber, pale white stone, undyed linen, worn leather brown, a thin red thread of lightning
casual: Her hauling clothes: a faded undyed coarse linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the shoulders, a worn leather jerkin whose shoulders are padded with three layers of leather, plain wool trousers tucked into heavy iron-shod boots worn thin at the soles, a length of hemp hauling rope wound round her waist with a water skin hanging from it. No weapon and no carrying frame: a whole rough white ashlar block rests on her right shoulder, steadied by one bare hand. A steady, unhurried look.
private: Off shift: the leather jerkin off, a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic belted with the hemp rope, soft old boots, a thick grey wool shawl round her shoulders against the north wind, her bare hands empty for once. She stands with her arms folded, a quiet, distant look, as if listening to the ground.
battle: Holding the line in human form: the padded leather jerkin buckled tight over the linen shirt, heavy leather bracers on both forearms, the hemp rope wound round both fists; she has no weapon. Pale stone-white scales surface along both forearms, at the back of her neck and on both cheekbones, a faint red crackle of lightning glowing in the seams of the scales, her amber eyes narrowed to vertical slits. She stands braced low with both open hands raised to shoulder height, palms up, as if bearing a great falling weight, feet planted wide; nothing in her hands. A grim, immovable look.
formal: At the wall's closing day: a clean undyed linen shirt under a long grey wool coat that closes down the front with plain horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a small brass button stamped with a sunrise pinned at the collar, clean wool trousers and oiled boots, her uneven ash-white hair combed flat. She stands straight with her bare hands at her sides, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes narrowed to vertical slits looking straight at the viewer, a few pale stone-white scales showing along her left cheekbone (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Cold grey north light from one side, a faint red lightning glow from below on the other. Foreground blur: drifting white stone dust and the rough edge of a white stone block.
dragon_form: Her true form, for a separate dragon sheet: a young true dragon of the Yellow-Rock line, drawn as a Western high-fantasy dragon (NOT a serpentine eastern dragon): four heavy legs and a separate pair of great wings. About sixty metres from snout to tail-tip, wingspan about ninety metres. A massive, thick-boned frame; pale rock scales as white as freshly quarried white limestone, laid in heavy overlapping slabs, with a ridge of upright plate-scales along the spine like a stony mountain crest. Two thick blunt horns sweep back from the brow, ringed with layered grooves like rock strata. Amber eyes with vertical slit pupils. Faint red sun-thunder glows in the seams between the scales and crackles in the throat when she breathes. Broad wings of thick grey-white membrane like weathered stone, the wing-bones pale. Heavy blunt claws. Her breath is a pale grey rock-mist laced with threads of red lightning; where it settles, earth and rubble fuse into solid stone. A calm, heavy, steady presence. In the long western campaign she grows gaunt, the ribs pressing up under the scales.
